gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.wakker: This little mailbox only works in a dream. At home it only gets junk mail.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.plein: Dream Post delivers you to: %s. Click an island's little mailbox to float there!
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.nergens: nowhere yet! First walk the cloud paths to an island, njeg.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.onbekend: You've never been there! Dream Post only delivers to known addresses. Take the cloud path to %s first.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.post0: You climb into the mailbox. Stamp on your nose, and... plop! Sent by registered mail.
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.post1: Dream Post, fast and soft. Do not crumple, njeg!
gui.guhs.droomplein.bus.post2: A big bubble takes you along. Sender: the Dream Square.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom0: of a cheese nibble as big as a house. It lives inside.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom1: that it can fly, but only a little bit, and then it lands in a box.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom2: that all the pillows in the world are its own. Njeg.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom3: of a Blub that says 'blub'. Nothing else happens. Beautiful dream.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom4: that it's the owner and you're the guh. You do get nibbles every day.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom5: of a rainbow made of cheese. It already took a bite.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom6: that it's in Guh Dreamland, dreaming that it's dreaming. Vahoeg.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom7: of a very long guh sled with every guh on the server in it. Somebody sits on its ear.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom8: that it got a whole cat house... and still lay down in the box.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom9: of a rubber duck that says 'njeg' instead of 'quack'. Or the other way round.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom10: that it's always Saturday morning, with cartoons and pancakes.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.droom11: that it's vadsier than ever. Incalculably vahoeg even.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.alleen0: The fountain bubbles. Everybody's asleep already, except you. It dreams you're a guh.
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.alleen1: The fountain dreams of a nibble. Oh wait, you just threw one in. Thank you!
gui.guhs.droomplein.fontein.alleen2: Shh... the fountain only hears a very soft 'njeg' far away.
